data.narrative:
Wispr AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg that has raised $81.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of nine comparable companies—one public (Palantir Technologies, ticker PLTR) and eight private firms spanning the same sector and stage cohort, including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $82M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $163M. Peer-median analysis across the five closest comparables in stage and sector produces a median valuation of $5.6B, though the peer range is wide ($2.0B to $29.0B), reflecting significant dispersion in the AI frontier-tech sector where valuations remain volatile and stage definitions overlap.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $139M to $6.4B, with a median point of $2.9B. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively to deployed capital; the peer-median method reflects market pricing but is constrained by high variance across the comparable set. Key uncertainties include revenue traction (not provided), burn rate, and relative competitive positioning within a rapidly repricing sector where peer valuations have widened materially in recent quarters.
